settings.definition_quote: we consider the non-stationary variance setting ... our goal is to quantify the regret by the cumulative variance proxy $V_T = \sum_{t \in [T]} \rho_t^2$ ... we suppose that the learner can access true variance proxy $\rho_t^2$ at the end of step $t$.
